body:
Proposed, not yet agreed. `zmux ls` prints one line per session of tab-separated k=v fields — the shape `zmx ls` already has, minus its leading indent, with the label fields kept — so awk, grep and bash read it without a parser, and jq works on `--json` when a program wants it. Filters are flags (`--project`, `--state`, `--attached`, `--ended`) rather than an expression language.

The point is not to invent a format: it is to add naming, normalisation and a filter to a format that already exists, so anything that understood zmx keeps working.
title: Output borrows zmx's own shape; JSON is opt-in
